messages:
tara (marketing): Quick sync — we’re targeting the Alpha release announcement tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final changelog link, docs URL, webinar slot (30-45m), benchmark narrative blurb, and inbound lead routing instructions. Can engineering confirm canary timing and changelog pointer?

josh (eng): Canary OK. Planning 9:30–9:55am PT, 20% -> 100% with a 15m watch window. Will post changelog draft in a sec: https://redwood.dev/changelog/alpha-rc1 (WIP).

leo (docs): Docs ready in draft at https://docs.redwood.dev/alpha. Need a short sample curl + node example to land before publish. I can trim the quickstart if you want to keep the announcement concise.

rachel (product): Messaging suggestion for the blog blurb: "Alpha launch: predictable, low-latency inference across hosted and private deployments — now with reserved canary rollouts and observability." Shorten as needed. Also propose 1-sentence webinar CTA: "Join our launch webinar to see real latency & cost wins."

devon (sales): For inbound routing: tag all webinar signups with `lead.source:alpha_webinar` and route to the SF AE queue. Intercom flow exists, I’ll add the rule if marketing confirms. Also we should add a separate nurture for Dedicated interest.

josh (eng): changelog updated: https://redwood.dev/changelog/alpha-rc1 — added note about canary fallback and rollback steps. Rollout config (for ops):

```
rollout:
  stage: canary
  percent: 20
  watch: 15m
  promote: on-success
  fallback: previous-model-v1
```

josh (eng): I’ll kick the deploy at 9:30 PT and monitor traces. If latency > 250ms for 3m we auto-fallback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment created by josh for 2024-06-18T09:30:00-07:00. CI checks passing. :rocket:

leo (docs): Pushed the sample code block and an abbreviated Getting Started. Docs canonical link for PR: https://docs.redwood.dev/alpha#quickstart — please point announcement to that anchor.

tara (marketing): Thanks — devon please go ahead and add the Intercom rule, confirm when done. Rachel, can you pick the final 2 variants of the headline (short + long) by EOD?

rachel (product): Short headline: "Redwood Alpha: Fast, predictable LLM inference". Long headline: "Redwood Alpha: unified inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with canary rollouts". I’ll drop both into the draft doc.

devon (sales): Intercom rule added and tested — sample leads appear in SF queue. Tagging format: alpha_webinar / campaign:alpha_launch.

josh (eng): Canary started on schedule. Early metrics look good — p50 120ms, p95 280ms (watching). No rollbacks so far.

leo (docs): Final docs link (published): https://docs.redwood.dev/alpha#quickstart — go ahead and point marketing assets here.

tara (marketing): Perfect. Marketing will schedule the blog post for 10:05am PT (announce after canary steady) and webhook the webinar CTA to the signup form. Bench narrative: lead with p50/p95 delta vs baseline, then call out batching/kv-cache improvements.

rachel (product): Webinar outline: 1) TL;DR & customer use cases, 2) demo (embedding + streaming generation), 3) benchmark deep-dive, 4) Q&A. Want a 20m demo + 15m bench + 10m Q&A.

josh (eng): If bench runtime needs ops help, ping me. I can export the perf trace and sample prompts.

tara (marketing): Final checklist: changelog -> https://redwood.dev/changelog/alpha-rc1, docs -> https://docs.redwood.dev/alpha#quickstart, webinar slot confirmed, inbound routing added. Everyone good for go? :thumbsup:

josh (eng): :thumbsup:

leo (docs): :thumbsup:

rachel (product): :thumbsup:

devon (sales): :thumbsup:

tara (marketing): Ok, we’ll publish 10:05am PT and start the webinar signup flow. Thanks all — I’ll post the announce copy here 30m before publish for a quick check.
